spin_selling.name: SPIN Selling
structure: Situation: Observe a specific fact about their storefront
Problem: Identify the hidden inefficiency or missing video capability
Implication: Highlight the business cost (higher bounce rates, wasted ad spend)
Need-Payoff: Show how Zeacon unlocks measurable conversion lift

challenger_sale.name: Challenger Sale
challenger_sale.guideline: Teach the prospect something counterintuitive about video commerce. Reframe static embeds as conversion leaks.

benchmarks.cart_abandonment: 69.8% average e-commerce cart abandonment rate (Baymard Institute)
benchmarks.time_on_site: Interactive video players increase dwell time by up to 4x
benchmarks.mobile_conversion: 73% of e-commerce traffic is mobile, where text-heavy pages bounce fastest

marketing.focus: ROAS, Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), and Social Ad Landing Page Alignment
marketing.tactic: Pitch converting social video ad traffic into checkout sales without losing engagement on static landing pages.
marketing.hook_style: Focus on turning paid traffic into immediate buyers.

ecommerce.focus: Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), Average Order Value (AOV), and Page Speed
ecommerce.tactic: Highlight Zeacon's lightweight asynchronous player that loads in <50ms with zero impact on Google Core Web Vitals.
ecommerce.hook_style: Focus on CRO wins and zero page-speed penalty.

founder.focus: Brand Loyalty, Scalable Revenue Growth, and Customer Engagement
founder.tactic: Show how top D2C brands turn product reviews and founder story videos into automated revenue engines.
founder.hook_style: High-level strategic vision and competitive advantage.
